Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner entered a looping pattern and failed to progress the task. After already confirming Elizabeth Berg’s birthplace and initiating a confluence check, the Planner repeatedly re-issued the same instructions (re-confirm birthplace, search for an impossible “border city,” and verify the confluence) without resolving contradictions or synthesizing results. This overreliance on redundant searches, lack of authoritative validation, and misframing of the intermediate city/body-of-water relationship stalled the process and risked leading to an unsubstantiated or incorrect conclusion.
